register_custom_mutator: use the register_mutator decorator to register a new mutator class in the Parlai mutator registry
load_mutator_types: load mutator classes from the registry by name using Mutator.load_mutator_types with plus-separated names
create_message_mutator: create a MessageMutator subclass that applies per-utterance text transformations to individual messages
create_episode_mutator: create an EpisodeMutator subclass that transforms entire episodes of messages at once
create_many_episode_mutator: create a ManyEpisodeMutator subclass that maps one episode to zero or more new episodes
